request.system: Assess whether the hypothesis or expression uses or tests numbered claims. Return JSON only: {"uses_claim": true|false, "claim_ids": []}.
request.prompt: {"claims": {"1": "**Migration Report**", "2": "**What worked (weakly):** The first attempt, a three-month change in the ratio of two turnover-type flow rates, ranked across groups, gave the only encouraging result.", "3": "Mean IC was 0.03 and the HAC t-stat was 1.42.", "4": "The signal was concentrated in low-T periods, and it was near zero in high-T periods.", "5": "It is suggestive, not significant.", "6": "**What failed:** Regime-gating a spread between two flow rates (submission 2) covered only 58% of observations and had no high-T output.", "7": "It gave a slightly negative IC.", "8": "The stock-versus-flow standardized spread (submission 3) was negative, at -1.18 HAC t, and correlated 0.33 with base features.", "9": "The pay-per-hours change was flat.", "10": "**Next:** Try changes in flow-rate ratios with longer smoothing, and avoid regime gating."}, "hypothesis": "Groups whose V05 year-over-year change, smoothed over three months and standardized against its own expanding history, is high will have higher next-month returns, because smoothing reduces noise in the positive signal and raises rank stability.", "expression": "mavg(tsz(yoy(V05),\"exp\"),3)"}
